name: lumen-web
description: Lumen: a study and focus coach that runs in the browser. The camera is processed on your own computer.

scripts.extension: rm -rf /tmp/lumen-focus && cp -r browser-extension /tmp/lumen-focus && rm -f static/lumen-focus.zip && (cd /tmp && zip -qr - lumen-focus) > static/lumen-focus.zip
